title: Executive Health
need: I'm responsible for the health of a team
summary: Assessments, a named physician and confidential specialist access for leadership teams, founders and family offices, with individual results that never reach the employer.
intro: Organisations come to us for two reasons: to look after people whose work is demanding and irregular, and to do it with the discretion those people would expect for themselves. We agree the programme with the organisation. Everything clinical stays between each person and their doctor.
image_alt: A woman reading a newspaper in a train carriage, window light across the seats
for_whom: People who travel constantly or are relocating internationally

includes.title: Annual assessments
includes.detail: The Comprehensive Assessment, scheduled around travel and board calendars.

includes.title: Physician access
includes.detail: A named physician and a direct line for each member, with appointments within one working day.

includes.title: Travel medicine
includes.detail: Vaccinations, malaria advice and a doctor's letter for medicines carried abroad.

includes.title: Anonymised reporting
includes.detail: Organisations see attendance and aggregated themes, never an individual's results.

process.detail: Who is covered, and what they actually need.

fees.note: Per person, per year. Assessment, membership and travel medicine.

faqs.a: Attendance and anonymised, aggregated themes, for example how many people were advised to look at their sleep. Never individual results, diagnoses or referrals.
